prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up portrait of a young man with flawless, fair skin and soft, natural makeup, gazing directly into the camera with a calm, enigmatic expression. His hair is styled in loose, tousled waves, with subtle brown highlights catching the cool, diffused light. He wears a black and white varsity-style jacket with a white shirt underneath, and a small, simple hoop earring in one ear, adding a touch of understated style. The background is softly blurred, featuring another figure partially visible and out of focus, wearing dark sunglasses and similar clothing, which adds depth and intrigue to the composition. The lighting is cool and even, with gentle shadows that sculpt the subject’s features, creating a cinematic, almost ethereal atmosphere. The color palette is dominated by cool blues, blacks, and whites, enhancing the modern, minimalist aesthetic. The camera angle is straight-on at eye level, with a shallow depth of field that isolates the main subject and draws attention to his serene yet intense gaze. The overall style is sleek, contemporary, and reminiscent of a high-fashion editorial or a stylish music video, with a focus on mood, subtle emotion, and visual clarity.
